Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your business name, location, website and category.
  2. Explain pickup, delivery, accessibility, returns and the easiest way to contact you.
  3. Use clear start and end dates for offers instead of leaving promotions open-ended.
  4. Track discovery separately from transactions, customers and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not make false stock, price or savings claims.
  • Keep normal search results separate from clearly labeled sponsorship.
  • Do not guarantee sales or revenue.
